description:
Compile .page markup and save it as the project's draft build. It never goes live until publish_build deploys it: call publish_build only when the user asks. Post changes rebuild the live site, not this draft.

Pass the whole site source each time (pages: [{ name: "landing.page", content }], extra .page files are merged after it by name). If the project's active build is a draft or a failed build it is overwritten; otherwise a new draft is created and made active. Returns the build id and number, compiler issues (such as a missing image file) and the editor URL where the user can preview the draft; drafts have no public URL.

Images are not uploaded here: call upload_asset first, then reference the file with `img: <- filename`. Call get_markup_reference before writing markup you are unsure of. Saving also registers the source's forms on the project.

llms_txt.description: The site's /llms.txt, stored verbatim. Omit to keep the current build's llms.txt; pass an empty string to remove it.

pages.description: The whole site source as one or more .page files, merged like the CLI does (landing.page first, then the others by name, a blank line between). Pass every file each time: this replaces the source, it does not patch it.

content.description: The complete .page markup of this file (not a diff).

name.description: File name ending in .page. landing.page is merged first; the rest follow sorted by name.

project.description: Which project: its uuid, its numeric id, its micropage hostname ("acme" or "acme.micropage.sh") or its custom domain ("www.acme.com"). A full URL also works. Get valid values from list_projects.

name: save_page

action.description: updated_draft: the active draft (or failed build) was overwritten. created_draft: a new draft was made active.

id.description: Build id; pass it to publish_build as build "id:<id>" to publish exactly this draft.

issues.description: Problems the compiler flagged, e.g. a referenced file that does not exist. Fix them before publishing.

live.description: Always false: save_page never changes the live site; the draft goes live only with publish_build.

live_url.description: The public URL; it still shows the last published build.

preview_url.description: Where the user can preview this draft: the project in the micropage editor.

domain.description: micropage slug: the site lives at https://<domain>.micropage.sh.

title: Save .page source as a draft
